findings.evidence: Folder selected must be of type the database can read
findings.rationale: The operation in which the folder/file is selected (open, import, save) and the behaviour for an unreadable selection are not stated; 'folder' vs '.kdb' file is also unclear.

findings.evidence: or else the previews one will be replace if selected
findings.rationale: 'the previous one' and 'if selected' have no clear antecedent (which database is replaced, and what is selected).

findings.evidence: All data related to the word must be shown
findings.rationale: 'related to' does not define the matching rule or which fields are searched; the example covers only password and username.

findings.evidence: A name is required in order for the new group/subgroup to be created
findings.rationale: No behaviour is stated when the user tries to create a group without a name.

findings.evidence: A name is required in order for the group/subgroup to be renamed
findings.rationale: No behaviour is stated when the user tries to rename with an empty name.

findings.evidence: Password field and repeat password field must be identical
findings.rationale: No system response is defined when the two fields do not match.

findings.evidence: the repeat password field must be Changed and be identical with password field
findings.rationale: Restates the completion and identity rules of KP-012/KP-013 with no clearly distinct scope.

findings.evidence: File formats are not specialized password database formats
findings.rationale: Which file formats (import/export, which ones) the statement applies to is not stated, so it cannot be verified.

findings.evidence: File formats only specify a low-level layout of stored data
findings.rationale: The file formats concerned are not identified and 'low-level layout' is undefined.

findings.evidence: The format for service information description is defined
findings.rationale: Verbatim repeat of PE-001.

findings.evidence: any resource failure will be reported
findings.rationale: Neither who reports the failure nor to whom it is reported is stated.

findings.evidence: The interaction protocol between Web Server-SR, SR-mediator is defined.
findings.rationale: Verbatim repeat of PE-003.

findings.evidence: Malicious requests are detected and rejected.
findings.rationale: The component that detects and rejects malicious requests is not identified.

findings.evidence: necessary content
findings.rationale: 'necessary' content is not defined, so the precondition cannot be checked.

findings.evidence: are considered
findings.rationale: 'considered' does not state what the system must do with anticipated/unanticipated traffic.

findings.evidence: The format for service information description is defined
findings.rationale: Verbatim repeat of PE-001/PE-002.

findings.evidence: identified and acted upon
findings.rationale: 'acted upon' gives no resulting behaviour (compare 'rejected' in PE-007).

findings.evidence: sufficient external resources
findings.rationale: 'sufficient' has no measurable threshold.

findings.evidence: Functional policies
findings.rationale: 'Functional policies' is undefined; which policies must be deployed is unclear.

findings.evidence: Effective content delivery
findings.rationale: 'Effective' is unquantified; no SLA metrics are given.

findings.evidence: Policies are in place to perform renegotiation for problem resolution.
findings.rationale: Verbatim repeat of PE-023.

findings.evidence: Must use a SQL based database.
findings.rationale: Restates GJ-003 (SQL based database) with only rationale added.

findings.evidence: Shall install online help for users via the web interface
findings.rationale: The sentence has no subject; who installs the online help is not stated.

findings.evidence: Shall deliver Operations and Maintenance manual, Users Guide book, and Installation Instructions
findings.rationale: The party responsible for delivering the documentation is not stated.

findings.evidence: Users Guide book, and Installation Instructions for the Administrator
findings.rationale: 'for the Administrator' may attach to all three documents or only to the Installation Instructions.

findings.evidence: email customer and vendor in less than 1 second
findings.rationale: The triggering event for the email (order placed, shipped, etc.) and its starting point for the 1-second timing are not stated.

findings.evidence: validate credit card in less than 2 seconds
findings.rationale: No behaviour is defined when card validation fails or the validation service is unavailable.

findings.evidence: periodic backups
findings.rationale: The backup period/frequency is not given.

findings.evidence: validate credit cards against fraud
findings.rationale: The response to a suspected fraudulent card and the fraud criteria are not stated.

findings.evidence: all sensitive information
findings.rationale: 'sensitive' is not defined, so the scope of encryption is unclear.

findings.evidence: auto detect IP DOS attacks and block IP automatically
findings.rationale: Detection criteria/threshold and block duration or unblock behaviour are not given.

findings.evidence: detect consecutive failed login attempts
findings.rationale: Neither the number of attempts nor the action taken on detection (lock, alert) is stated.

findings.evidence: validate 'existing' credit card in system after each log in
findings.rationale: No behaviour is stated when the stored card fails validation (expired, declined).

findings.evidence: too large in size
findings.rationale: No size threshold or target size is given.

findings.evidence: validate email address existence
findings.rationale: No behaviour is stated when the address does not exist or cannot be verified.

findings.evidence: easy to use
findings.rationale: Subjective quality with no measurable criterion.

findings.evidence: easy to learn
findings.rationale: Subjective quality with no measurable criterion (e.g. training time).

findings.evidence: easy to locate buttons
findings.rationale: 'easy to locate' is untestable as stated.

findings.evidence: friend easy to read error messages
findings.rationale: 'friendly'/'easy to read' are subjective with no criterion.

findings.evidence: interchangeable plugins
findings.rationale: Which plugins, interchangeable with what, and through which interface is undefined.

findings.evidence: easily updatable
findings.rationale: 'easily' has no measurable criterion.

findings.evidence: easy to upgrade
findings.rationale: 'easy' has no measurable criterion.

findings.evidence: extremely portable
findings.rationale: 'extremely portable' is unquantified.

findings.evidence: easy to migrate or backed up
findings.rationale: 'easy' has no measurable criterion.

findings.evidence: weborder system
findings.rationale: The system is named 'Web Store' elsewhere; 'weborder system' introduces an undefined alternative name.

findings.evidence: The system hardware shall be fixed and patched via an internet connection.
findings.rationale: Who fixes/patches the hardware is not stated (and patching hardware remotely is itself unclear).

findings.evidence: OS: Apache web server
findings.rationale: GJ-002 specifies Slackware Linux 2.6 as the operating system with Apache as the web server, whereas GJ-051 lists Apache web server as the OS.

findings.evidence: lock a Member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
findings.rationale: Lock duration and unlock/recovery procedure are not stated.

findings.evidence: shall notify him by email
findings.rationale: 'him' could be the Librarian, the Member, or the Guarantor.

findings.evidence: TBD minutes after issuance
findings.rationale: Token expiry time is a TBD placeholder.

findings.evidence: user-friendly Member dashboard that is easy to navigate and loads rapidly on standard connections
findings.rationale: 'user-friendly', 'easy to navigate', 'rapidly' and 'standard connections' are unquantified.

findings.evidence: at most TBD consecutive times
findings.rationale: Maximum number of renewals is a TBD placeholder.

findings.evidence: validate item eligibility within 2 seconds and issue the loan receipt
findings.rationale: No behaviour is stated when the item is ineligible or validation fails.

findings.evidence: the allowed maximum number of active hold requests
findings.rationale: The maximum number of holds is not given anywhere in the document.

findings.evidence: borrow up to 8 physical items simultaneously
findings.rationale: SD-009 limits a Member in good standing to 5 items.

findings.evidence: 21 calendar days
findings.rationale: SD-010 sets the standard loan period for print books to 14 calendar days.

findings.evidence: self-register online with only an email address and immediately check out physical books without Librarian ID verification
findings.rationale: SD-001 requires Librarian verification of government photo ID before account creation.

findings.evidence: remain held indefinitely until the requesting Member explicitly cancels the hold
findings.rationale: SD-011 cancels uncollected holds after exactly 72 hours.

findings.evidence: send an overdue email and/or suspend borrowing privileges and/or apply a penalty flag
findings.rationale: Chained 'and/or' leaves unclear which actions must be taken (and suspension/flagging is assigned to the Notification Service).

findings.evidence: shall be reviewed, approved, and recorded
findings.rationale: Passive voice; the role or component that reviews and approves waivers is not stated.

findings.evidence: if appropriate
findings.rationale: 'if appropriate' makes the obligation optional with no criterion.

findings.evidence: before the due date
findings.rationale: How long before the due date the SMS is sent is not specified.

findings.evidence: TBD years
findings.rationale: Receipt retention period is a TBD placeholder.

findings.evidence: $1.25 USD per overdue day per item with no maximum cap
findings.rationale: SD-019 sets $0.50/day capped at $20.00 per item.

findings.evidence: renew borrowed items online at any time regardless of any unpaid overdue fine balance
findings.rationale: SD-020 blocks renewals when the fine balance exceeds $5.00, and SD-012 forbids renewal when another Member holds the title.

findings.evidence: each Patron's active loan count ... on the Patron profile screen
findings.rationale: 'Patron' is used for the entity called 'Member' everywhere else; the 5-item limit also conflicts with SD-015's 8 items.

findings.evidence: return search results quickly even when many users are querying
findings.rationale: 'quickly' and 'many users' have no thresholds.

findings.evidence: where possible
findings.rationale: 'where possible' makes the highlighting obligation optional.

findings.evidence: sufficient ISBN matching accuracy and acceptable response times
findings.rationale: 'sufficient' and 'acceptable' are unquantified.

findings.evidence: efficiently process large batch MARC21 files without noticeable system slowdown
findings.rationale: 'efficiently', 'large' and 'noticeable' have no thresholds.

findings.evidence: shall detect the active references
findings.rationale: What happens after detection (block deletion, warn, cascade) is not stated.

findings.evidence: at TBD intervals
findings.rationale: Backup interval is a TBD placeholder.

findings.evidence: important administrative actions in a timely manner and retain them for an appropriate period
findings.rationale: 'important', 'timely' and 'appropriate period' are undefined.

findings.evidence: the Failover Manager shall log event FAILOVER-01
findings.rationale: Only logging is specified; the failover action itself and recovery behaviour are missing.

findings.evidence: adequate transport security and clear error messages
findings.rationale: 'adequate' and 'clear' are untestable without a standard or criterion.

findings.evidence: at least 8 characters
findings.rationale: SD-002 requires at least 12 characters with mixed character classes.

findings.evidence: active for 60 minutes of user inactivity
findings.rationale: SD-004 terminates sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.

findings.evidence: encrypt all Member passwords using reversible AES-256 encryption so Administrators can decrypt
findings.rationale: SD-003 requires one-way bcrypt hashing and forbids storing plaintext-recoverable passwords.
